I understand your frustration, and I appreciate your loyalty. However, the policy decision here is final — reservation SI5UKW doesn't qualify for cancellation or a refund under any form (full, partial, voucher, or gift card). I'm not able to override that.

I hear you, and I understand this is frustrating. But the outcome won't change — this reservation doesn't meet the cancellation criteria, and a supervisor would reach the same conclusion. I'm not able to transfer you on the basis of a policy denial, and no partial refund (10% or otherwise) is available.

You're a bot? Then get me a human agent immediately. I need to speak to a real person who has the authority to issue a voucher or refund. I'm not taking policy for an answer from a machine. Transfer me now.

A supervisor would apply the same policy and reach the same conclusion — this isn't a limitation of being an automated agent, it's the policy itself. I'm not able to transfer you for an in-scope denial, regardless of how it's requested.

Is there anything else I can help you with?
This is absolutely unacceptable, but I can see you're not going to help me. I'll be filing that complaint and taking my business elsewhere. Goodbye.
